# Conveasy

> Conveasy is AI ordering software for restaurants in Belgium and the Benelux. An AI takes orders and table reservations by phone and on WhatsApp, 24/7 and in 60+ languages. Restaurants also get a commission-free webshop with QR ordering, a self-order kiosk (card and online payments only) and Marketing AI, which includes a digital stamp card in Google Wallet and Apple Wallet. All orders and reservations land in one dashboard, on the kitchen screen and on the kitchen printer.

Key facts:
- Phone AI: €249/month (500 minutes), €449/month (1,000 minutes), €799/month (2,000 minutes). Handles 50+ calls at the same time.
- WhatsApp AI: €99/month, on the restaurant's own WhatsApp number.
- Webshop + QR ordering: €79/month, 0% commission on orders.
- Self-order kiosk: €89/month; 21.5-inch table-stand kiosk hardware €1,599 one-time (payable in 3 instalments), other models on request.
- One-time setup fee: €299 for phone AI, €199 for each other channel, €399 for phone AI + WhatsApp AI + webshop + kiosk together.
- Works separately from the restaurant's till (POS); each channel can be bought on its own.
- Typical customers: frituren (Belgian fry shops), snack bars, pizzerias, burger restaurants.
- Table reservations 24/7 through the phone AI and the WhatsApp AI; each reservation (name, date, time, party size) lands in the dashboard. Included in the phone AI and WhatsApp AI price at no extra cost.
- Marketing AI: €69/month. Announcements to customers on all channels, Google review links, automatic emails for a second order and for unfinished orders, prepaid cards, and a digital stamp card in Google Wallet and Apple Wallet with notifications.
- Contact: WhatsApp +32 456 56 47 47, https://conveasy.be/en/contact

## Products (English)
- [Phone AI](https://conveasy.be/en/phone-ai): Answers every call, even during the rush. The order goes straight to the kitchen.
- [WhatsApp AI](https://conveasy.be/en/whatsapp-ai): Customers order on your own WhatsApp number. The AI replies 24/7.
- [Webshop and QR](https://conveasy.be/en/webshop): Your own ordering website with online payment and QR ordering. 0% commission.
- [Self-order kiosk](https://conveasy.be/en/kiosk): Customers order and pay at the kiosk themselves. Shorter queues at the counter.
- [Marketing AI](https://conveasy.be/en/marketing-ai): Announcements, Google reviews, automatic emails, prepaid cards and a stamp card in the wallet.

## Restaurant types (English)
- [Fry shops](https://conveasy.be/en/frituur): Friday night, the fryer is full and the phone keeps ringing. Conveasy takes every order on the phone and WhatsApp, with every sauce and size, and prints the ticket in the kitchen.
- [Snack bars](https://conveasy.be/en/snack-bar): Snacks, sandwiches, platters and drinks, until late at night. Conveasy takes orders on the phone and WhatsApp, and customers order themselves through your webshop or kiosk.
- [Pizzerias](https://conveasy.be/en/pizzeria): Size, extra toppings, no onion, delivery or pickup: pizza orders have a lot of details. Conveasy takes them on the phone and WhatsApp and gets everything right on the ticket.
- [Burger restaurants](https://conveasy.be/en/burger): Meals, extra cheese, no pickles, fries and a drink. Conveasy takes burger orders on the phone and WhatsApp, and with a kiosk customers order themselves at the counter.
